canonical_term: Certification of Completion of Expedited Community Redevelopment Plan TIF Project
summary: DOR PAD standard certification form used after completion of an expedited review redevelopment project to certify completion, valuation increase, amount of increase, and that the increase was due to improvements.
plain_language: This is the back-end assessor certification before the CRA can begin using the increment for the Micro-TIF note.

facts.object: Certification of Completion of Expedited Community Redevelopment Plan Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Project (10/2020)

object: valuation increase was due to improvements made

facts.object: after redeveloper notifies county assessor of completion and assessor determines completion and assessed value
authority may begin using the sec. 18-2147 increment portion to pay sec. 18-2155 indebtedness after certification

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Property Assessment Forms, Tax Increment Financing.
Nebraska DED, Application for Expedited Review instructions, reissued June 2023.
